tokens.name: surface-page
tokens.usage: Page background. Dark theme is the website default; light (bone paper) is for editorial pages.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Sections, header and footer.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, inputs, size and color pickers.

tokens.name: surface-overlay
tokens.usage: Drawers, menus, the bag panel.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines, dividers and thorn rules. Decorative only: never the only border of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs and secondary buttons. At least 3:1 on every surface in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and the wordmark, on every surface token.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text and body copy under headings, on every surface token.

tokens.name: ink-subtle
tokens.usage: Captions and metadata on surface-page, surface and surface-raised (4.6:1 or better). Dark theme: not on surface-overlay (4.0:1).

tokens.name: accent-text
tokens.usage: Copper 300 (dark) / faded burgundy (light): text links, the bag count, hover states, form errors. On surface-page, surface, surface-raised. Dark theme: on surface-overlay only at 18px+ (4.4:1).

tokens.name: scripture
tokens.usage: Scripture references only, on any surface token (5.3:1 or better).

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Oxblood. Primary button fill on coal, the active category underline, text selection, the signature wordmark ink. Never as text on dark surfaces (1.9:1).

tokens.name: primary-hover
tokens.usage: Primary button hover and pressed fill.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Text and icons on primary and primary-hover (7.7:1).

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus: 2px solid ring with a 2px offset. Inside altar panels use on-altar; inside feature panels use on-feature.

tokens.name: panel-feature
tokens.usage: Washed oxblood. Drop banners and collection features. Text on it is on-feature or on-feature-muted only.

tokens.name: on-feature
tokens.usage: Text, rules and focus on panel-feature (7.5:1).

tokens.name: on-feature-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on panel-feature (5.1:1).

tokens.name: altar
tokens.usage: Warm bone. Altar panels: the About story, collection intros, newsletter. Carries the signature oxblood wordmark.

tokens.name: on-altar
tokens.usage: Text and focus ring on altar (13.7:1).

tokens.name: on-altar-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on altar (7.2:1).

tokens.name: altar-mark
tokens.usage: Wordmark and Thorn Cross on altar (7.1:1). Also headings there at 24px+.

tokens.name: altar-scripture
tokens.usage: Scripture references on altar (5.1:1).

tokens.name: panel-inverse
tokens.usage: Color blocks that must contrast with the page in both themes (cover, campaign layouts). Never a text ground in UI.

tokens.name: brand-coal
tokens.usage: Brand color: coal, sampled from the logo files. Functional dark wordmark ground; signature coal ink on paper.

tokens.name: brand-bone
tokens.usage: Brand color: bone, sampled from the logo files. Wordmark ink on coal.

tokens.name: brand-oxblood
tokens.usage: Brand color: oxblood. Signature wordmark ink on warm bone.

tokens.name: brand-warm-bone
tokens.usage: Brand color: warm bone. Signature lockup ground, hang tags, labels, packaging.

tokens.name: bb-copper
tokens.usage: Secondary: oxidized copper. Illustration, rules, badges, hover borders. As text only at 24px+ (3.7:1 on coal).

tokens.name: bb-faded-burgundy
tokens.usage: Secondary: faded burgundy. Text and accents on bone and paper (4.8:1 or better).

tokens.name: bb-washed-oxblood
tokens.usage: Secondary: washed oxblood. Same value as panel-feature; use panel-feature in UI.

tokens.name: bb-charcoal
tokens.usage: Secondary: charcoal. Garment base, photo backdrops.

tokens.name: copper-300
tokens.usage: Copper 300: accent text on dark. Same value as accent-text in the dark theme; use accent-text in UI.

tokens.name: scripture-gold
tokens.usage: Scripture gold on coal. Same value as scripture in the dark theme; use scripture in UI.

fonts.source: @fontsource-variable/grenze-gotisch (latin, wght 100-900), self-hosted on the site; Google Fonts elsewhere
@fontsource-variable/manrope (latin, wght 200-800), self-hosted on the site; Google Fonts elsewhere
@fontsource/cormorant-garamond, latin 500 italic only, self-hosted on the site; Google Fonts elsewhere

families.scripture: var(--font-cormorant, "Cormorant Garamond"), Georgia, "Times New Roman", serif

groups.name: Display
groups.note: Grenze Gotisch, weight 600. Lettering at poster size: the tagline, release names ("Behold" filling the width), each piece's call on its plate, page titles. Always mixed case. Never paragraphs, sizing, prices or numerals (they turn to blackletter shapes). Classes: .aw-poster, .aw-fit, .aw-h1, .aw-h2, .aw-display.

styles.name: poster
styles.sample: Bound in awe. Worn without shame.
styles.usage: Lettering at poster size (.aw-poster). Each use sets its own size in container units so its longest line fits.

styles.name: fit
styles.usage: A release name filling its line (.aw-fit). --ems is the name's width in ems.

styles.name: display
styles.sample: Bound in awe. Worn without shame.
styles.usage: The brand Hero's headline (marketing builds). text-wrap: balance.

groups.name: Scripture
groups.note: Cormorant Garamond Italic 500 (a genuine italic file). Scripture quotations only, inside curly double quotes; no added letter spacing. The reference sits beneath in upright Manrope (scripture-ref). Classes: .aw-quote, or ScriptureQuote with size sm / md / lg.

styles.name: quote
styles.sample: “If I only touch his cloak, I will be healed.”
styles.usage: Beside a product name (ScriptureQuote size md). Mobile 21px.

styles.name: quote-sm
styles.sample: “For to me, to live is Christ and to die is gain.”

styles.name: quote-lg
styles.sample: “I planted the seed, Apollos watered it, but God has been making it grow.”

groups.name: Text
groups.note: Manrope (variable). Everything else: body, navigation, labels, buttons, prices, filters, forms, sizing, Scripture references and product names. No font-stretch, no faux styles.

styles.name: product-name
styles.usage: Product name on the product page, caps (.aw-product-name). Mobile 18/24px.

styles.name: card-name
styles.usage: Product name on cards, caps (.aw-card-name); accent-text on hover. Phones 16/21px.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Every piece tells part of His story in bold art and lettering.
styles.usage: Body copy in ink-muted, max 62ch (.aw-body). Mobile 16/26px.

styles.name: small
styles.sample: Made to order. Shipping is calculated at checkout.

styles.name: nav
styles.usage: Header links, account and bag, caps.

styles.name: meta
styles.usage: Prices and small figures in accent-text, caps, tabular figures (.aw-meta). Never a design code.

styles.name: scripture-ref
styles.usage: Scripture references in the scripture color, caps, with 32px rules (.aw-scripture). The translation part is weight 600. 11.5px in cards.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to label.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inside chips and tight groups.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between related rows; button groups.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding; mobile page gutter.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between blocks inside a section.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Grid gap for product cards.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Desktop page gutter; panel padding.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Between sections on mobile.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Between sections on desktop; hero padding.

radius.note: Sharp. No pills, no soft cards.

tokens.name: radius-0
tokens.usage: Default for everything: cards, panels, images, chips.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons and inputs only. The maximum radius anywhere.

shadow.note: Depth comes from layered coal surfaces; shadows are rare.

tokens.name: shadow-raised
tokens.usage: Drawers, menus and the bag panel only.

tokens.name: glow-primary
tokens.usage: The oxblood glow behind the brand Hero text or a featured product in posts. The site itself uses no glows.

tokens.name: container-max
tokens.usage: Max width of the page frame, so the header, page content and full-bleed bands share one edge. Text keeps its own measure.

tokens.name: gutter-mobile
tokens.usage: Page side padding under 768px.

tokens.name: gutter-desktop
tokens.usage: Page side padding from 768px.

tokens.name: gutter
tokens.usage: The page's side padding at the current width: gutter-mobile under 768px.

tokens.name: tap-min
tokens.usage: Minimum touch target.

tokens.name: header-height
tokens.usage: Sticky header height; 64px under 768px. Also the scroll padding, so anchors land below the header.

motion.note: Short rises and fades. Words, Scripture and buttons stay readable at every frame; honor prefers-reduced-motion.

tokens.name: ease-reverent
tokens.usage: Default easing for rises, drawers and the menu icon.

tokens.name: duration-fast
tokens.usage: Hover and color changes.

tokens.name: duration-base
tokens.usage: Image cross-fades, drawers, the menu.
